views.definition:
SELECT r.id AS route_id,
    r.route_date,
    r.wave,
    r.status,
    r.driver_employee_number,
    e.display_name AS driver_display_name,
    r.estimated_miles,
    r.estimated_minutes,
    r.paused_at,
    r.resumed_at,
    r.pause_reason,
    rs.started_at,
    COALESCE(ss.total_stops, 0::bigint)::integer AS total_stops,
    COALESCE(ss.delivered_stops, 0::bigint)::integer AS delivered_stops,
    COALESCE(ss.failed_stops, 0::bigint)::integer AS failed_stops,
    COALESCE(ss.pending_stops, 0::bigint)::integer AS pending_stops,
    COALESCE(ss.pending_priority, 0::bigint)::integer AS pending_priority,
    COALESCE(ss.pending_hot_shot, 0::bigint)::integer AS pending_hot_shot,
    COALESCE(ss.overdue_promises, 0::bigint)::integer AS overdue_promises,
    COALESCE(ss.due_soon_promises, 0::bigint)::integer AS due_soon_promises,
    COALESCE(ex.open_exceptions, 0::bigint)::integer AS open_exceptions,
    ns.stop_id AS next_stop_id,
    ns.stop_sequence AS next_stop_sequence,
    ns.customer_name AS next_customer_name,
    ns.address AS next_address,
    ns.priority AS next_priority,
    ns.promised_by AS next_promised_by,
    ns.sales_order_no AS next_sales_order_no,
    ns.lat AS next_lat,
    ns.lon AS next_lon,
    lg.captured_at AS gps_captured_at,
    lg.lat AS gps_lat,
    lg.lon AS gps_lon,
    lg.accuracy_m AS gps_accuracy_m,
    lg.speed_mps AS gps_speed_mps
   FROM delivery_routes r
     LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.employee_number = r.driver_employee_number
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT min(delivery_events.created_at) AS started_at
           FROM delivery_events
          WHERE delivery_events.route_id = r.id AND delivery_events.event_type = 'ROUTE_STARTED'::text) rs ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS total_stops,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'DELIVERED'::text) AS delivered_stops,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = ANY (ARRAY['NOT_DELIVERED'::text, 'SKIPPED'::text])) AS failed_stops,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'PENDING'::text) AS pending_stops,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'PENDING'::text AND (upper(COALESCE(o.priority, 'NORMAL'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['PRIORITY'::text, 'HOT_SHOT'::text]))) AS pending_priority,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'PENDING'::text AND upper(COALESCE(o.priority, 'NORMAL'::text)) = 'HOT_SHOT'::text) AS pending_hot_shot,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'PENDING'::text AND o.promised_by IS NOT NULL AND o.promised_by < now()) AS overdue_promises,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'PENDING'::text AND o.promised_by IS NOT NULL AND o.promised_by >= now() AND o.promised_by <= (now() + '00:30:00'::interval)) AS due_soon_promises
           FROM delivery_route_stops s
             JOIN delivery_orders o ON o.id = s.order_id
          WHERE s.route_id = r.id) ss ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.id AS stop_id,
            s.stop_sequence,
            o.customer_name,
            o.address,
            o.priority,
            o.promised_by,
            o.sales_order_no,
            o.lat,
            o.lon
           FROM delivery_route_stops s
             JOIN delivery_orders o ON o.id = s.order_id
          WHERE s.route_id = r.id AND s.status = 'PENDING'::text
          ORDER BY s.stop_sequence
         LIMIT 1) ns ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT delivery_driver_locations.captured_at,
            delivery_driver_locations.lat,
            delivery_driver_locations.lon,
            delivery_driver_locations.accuracy_m,
            delivery_driver_locations.speed_mps
           FROM delivery_driver_locations
          WHERE delivery_driver_locations.route_id = r.id
          ORDER BY delivery_driver_locations.captured_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) lg ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS open_exceptions
           FROM delivery_exceptions x
          WHERE x.route_id = r.id AND x.status = 'OPEN'::text) ex ON true
  WHERE r.status = ANY (ARRAY['ACTIVE'::text, 'PLANNED'::text]);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nwtb_claim_mapbox_request(p_limit bigint DEFAULT 90000)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_month date := date_trunc('month', now())::date;
  v_count bigint;
begin
  insert into public.delivery_navigation_usage(month_key, mapbox_requests, updated_at)
  values (v_month, 0, now())
  on conflict (month_key) do nothing;

  update public.delivery_navigation_usage
     set mapbox_requests = mapbox_requests + 1,
         updated_at = now()
   where month_key = v_month
     and mapbox_requests < greatest(0, p_limit)
  returning mapbox_requests into v_count;

  return found;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nwtb_delivery_has_permission(p_employee_number text, p_permission text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1
    from public.nwtb_delivery_roles r
    join public.nwtb_delivery_role_permissions p on p.role=r.role
    where r.employee_number=p_employee_number
      and r.active=true
      and p.permission=upper(p_permission)
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nwtb_delivery_role_for(p_employee_number text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case
    when r.active is true then r.role
    else null
  end
  from public.nwtb_delivery_roles r
  where r.employee_number=p_employee_number
  limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nwtb_route_needs_return(p_route jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(nullif(p_route->>'end_mode',''),'RETURN_DEPOT') <> 'LAST_STOP'
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nwtb_stop_update_route_phase()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.status IN ('DELIVERED','NOT_DELIVERED','SKIPPED')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.delivery_routes WHERE id=NEW.route_id AND status='ACTIVE') THEN
  PERFORM public.nwtb_finish_route_stops(NEW.route_id,(SELECT driver_employee_number FROM public.delivery_routes WHERE id=NEW.route_id));
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
